# AI Executable Commands Document
#
# This file is auto-generated by Kilacraft-AI with built-in plugin commands.
# Add commands from other plugins and custom commands below.
# Run /kila reload after editing to apply changes.
#
# This file is independent from the knowledge base (knowledge/ directory),
# used only for AI command execution skill intent recognition.
#
# [Format]
# Each command: ## command_name (no leading /), followed by fields:
#   description: What the command does
#   example: Full invocation (with arguments)
#   permission: Server permission node required to run this command
#               (AI filters by player permission on injection; unauthorized commands are hidden from AI)
#   keywords: Words players might use (optional, comma-separated)
#
# [Example]
# ## home
# description: Teleport to your set home
# example: home [home_name]
# permission: essentials.home
# keywords: go home, teleport home
#
# ============ Kilacraft-AI Built-in Commands ============

## kila clear
description: Clear your AI conversation history
example: kila clear
permission: kilacraft.clear.self
keywords: clear chat, reset conversation, start over

## kila clear <player>
description: Clear another player's AI conversation history (admin permission required)
example: kila clear Steve
permission: kilacraft.clear.other
keywords: clear others chat, clear someone conversation

## kila usage
description: View your AI usage statistics
example: kila usage
permission: kilacraft.query.self
keywords: usage, statistics, consumption

## kila history
description: View your AI conversation history
example: kila history
permission: kilacraft.query.self
keywords: chat history, conversation log

## kila memory
description: View your player profile and AI memory
example: kila memory
permission: kilacraft.query.self
keywords: my profile, AI memory, what do you know about me

## kila tasks
description: View scheduled task status (admin permission required)
example: kila tasks
permission: kilacraft.tasks
keywords: scheduled tasks, task status, background tasks

## kila reload
description: Reload Kilacraft-AI plugin config (admin permission required)
example: kila reload
permission: kilacraft.reload
keywords: reload, refresh config

## kila doctor
description: Plugin health self-check (admin permission required)
example: kila doctor
permission: kilacraft.admin.info
keywords: self-check, diagnose, health

## kila about
description: View plugin version and update info (admin permission required)
example: kila about
permission: kilacraft.admin.info
keywords: version, about, update

## kila cache
description: View AI cache hit rate statistics (admin permission required)
example: kila cache
permission: kilacraft.admin.cache
keywords: cache hit rate, cache statistics, hit ratio

## kila cache reset
description: Reset cache hit rate statistics counters (admin permission required)

## kila knowledge reload

## kila personalities reload

## kila notify test

## kila profile start
description: Start manual performance sampling (admin permission required)
example: kila profile start
permission: kilacraft.admin.health
keywords: performance sampling, start sampling

## kila profile stop
description: Stop manual performance sampling and generate report (admin permission required)
example: kila profile stop
permission: kilacraft.admin.health
keywords: stop sampling, end sampling

## kila profile status
description: View current performance sampling status (admin permission required)
example: kila profile status
permission: kilacraft.admin.health
keywords: sampling status
